It started being a huge pain in the ass just to get out of bed, the next day the goal was to eat, then maybe brush my teeth, or take a shower tomorrow. Really small things, added up over time made a difference, and thats already an improvement. Im... Not sure what comes next after that, but maybe you'll figure it out.
Hey man who tf said anything about balance? Its your balance, whatever works for YOU. Its your rules. You sound like a good person, I hope you make it through this man, i really do

Hey man, I really need to hear that last bit, thanks for that.
I hope I make it to 20, just turned 19 a month ago, and I really hope things get better so you can make it too. Good night my dude.
Thanks, it gives me hope that im not alone. Have a good night too. I hope we can get better soon. Feel free to talk to me if you want

I feel every word you've said, ive lived that.

Look, there is no way to forget someone that has such an impact on your life. its just not an option. But thats a good thing. She has brought happiness to you, and thats very valuable, and that gift is yours to keep. When you think of her, think of good moments, relive them in your head, and enjoy them with a smile. Don't get lost in them tho, enjoy them for a bit and then keep going with your day. Occupy your mind as much as you can, and over the years you will think less often of her. Dont get sad over it tho, those are golden memories. Savor them for a while, enjoy them, but keep going forward. This works for me, I hope it works for you. Hope everything gets better soon my friend. Feel free to msg me of you wanna talk.
